name: codex-vivado
description: Vivado MCP integration, offline evidence analysis and FPGA workflow skills for Codex. Built on machine=PC2.

interface.shortDescription: Vivado tools, reports and evidence-based FPGA workflows
interface.longDescription: Connect your own vivado-mcp installation, inspect offline reports, manage authorized builds and hardware debugging, and search public AMD documentation. No Vivado installation or license is included.
defaultPrompt: Use $vivado-workflow to inspect this project and report the next evidence-backed step.
Use $vivado-reports to analyze my timing report without starting Vivado.
Use $amd-doc-search to verify public Vivado Tcl documentation for my installed version.
